feedback.problem: Write the equation of the hyperbola $5{x}^{2}-6{y}^{2}=60$ in standard form.
feedback.worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a horizontal hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $60$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5{x}^{2}-6{y}^{2} & =60 \\ \frac{5{x}^{2}}{60}-\frac{6{y}^{2}}{60} & =\frac{60}{60} \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{12}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{10} & =1\end{aligned}
$$
